facts.fact: SADC says Eswatini was among twelve member states whose ministers or representatives attended the SADC Ministers for ICT, Information, Transport and Meteorology meeting in Dar es Salaam on 19-20 September 2019, where frameworks such as the Regional CIRT framework were approved.
